steps.en: Install it into a Python 3.10–3.13 environment on the GPU host
steps.zh: 在 GPU 主机的 Python 3.10–3.13 环境里安装

steps.en: Quantize the model's weights to 4-bit into a work directory
steps.zh: 把模型权重量化成 4-bit，写进一个工作目录

steps.en: Calibrates on sample text and writes AWQ 4-bit weights to the directory
steps.zh: 用样本文本校准，把 AWQ 4-bit 权重写进该目录
把量化后的模型对外服务

steps.en: Loads it into the TurboMind engine and batches concurrent requests with a paged KV cache
steps.zh: 装进 TurboMind 引擎，用分页 KV 缓存把并发请求合批处理
在 23333 端口响应 OpenAI 兼容请求

value.en: A model that did not fit in FP16 serves several concurrent users on the same GPU, behind an API your OpenAI clients already speak
value.zh: 原本 FP16 放不下的模型，在同一块 GPU 上同时服务多个用户，接口还是现有 OpenAI 客户端能直接调的

sources: https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy/blob/main/docs/en/quantization/w4a16.md (lmdeploy lite auto_awq internlm/internlm2_5-7b-chat --work-dir internlm2_5-7b-chat-4bit; lmdeploy serve api_server ./internlm2_5-7b-chat-4bit --backend turbomind --model-format awq)
